state:
Goal `core-uuid`: `Core\Uuid::fromBytes`, `parse`, `toBytes`, `v4`, `v7` and `tryParse` have all
their feature proofs. Their cards in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs` are in the plain voice. The
class card is done. Only `toString` is still owed: examples, hostile, perf, a Rust `covers:`
marker, and a plain-voice `TO_STRING_DOC`.

`tests/hostile/core/Uuid/tryParse/01-huge-broken-and-almost-valid-texts.nvs` carries
`// proof: gap nvs-runtime/a-core-call-with-a-large-string-costs-time-per-byte`. Any `Core` call
whose argument is a 50 MB `string` costs about 0.7 ms, and `Core\Str::startsWith` costs the same, so
the cause is outside `Core\Uuid`. The gap record says what was measured. It is owned by M12 and is
not this goal's to fix.

next.title: the last member, then the goal's end gates
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs` plus the `toString` proof trees.

items.text: **`Core\Uuid::toString`**: examples, hostile, perf, a plain-voice `TO_STRING_DOC`, and `covers: Core\Uuid::toString` on `the_canonical_form_parses_in_either_case_and_renders_lower` (it already carries `covers: Core\Uuid::parse`, so extend that line). It is an instance member, so a `.nvst` case that calls `->toString()` needs a `covers:` marker too: the check still reads `tests: 0 of 2 cases` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs:311`

**Close the goal**: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Uuid'`, then `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes core-uuid` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-uuid`, then `DONE` (`rule:testing/a-failing-proof-is-fixed-or-recorded` for the marked tryParse attack). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uuid.rs:136`

backlog: The per-byte cost of a large `string` argument at the `Core` call boundary: `data/gaps/nvs-runtime/a-core-call-with-a-large-string-costs-time-per-byte.json`, owned by M12.
